spec.description: Operator view of the cabinet for TODAY: attract mode vs. playing, aliveness (heartbeat + events), coin-box economics (coins + revenue @ $0.25/coin + credits available), usage by hour, music popularity, and the raw log feed. Click a host in the Host Selector to scope the whole board — for when multiple cabinets share this Loki instance. Content-first cut; layout/styling to be refined.

spec.title: 🖥️ Host Selector
spec.description: Every cabinet (host_name) active in the selected time range (today, by default). Click a row to scope the whole board to that cabinet — useful once more than one is deployed.

spec.title: 📍 Selected host
spec.description: Which host the rest of this board is scoped to. Click a row in Host Selector (or type one) to change it.

spec.title: 🎮 Engine state
spec.description: What's happening right now on the selected host: ATTRACT MODE, PLAYING, POST GAME (game.gameover fired — GAME OVER text / bonus road / course map / high-score table / name entry — but game.session.end hasn't landed yet), or UNKNOWN if the host hasn't logged anything in the last 60s (same check as Alive) — an abandoned/killed session never logs game.session.end, so without this fallback a dead cabinet's last game would show PLAYING or POST GAME forever. Confirmed live 2026-10-07 — a session cut short by stopping the Pi stayed PLAYING indefinitely.

spec.expr: (1 - ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" [60s])) or vector(0)) > bool 0)) * 3 + ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" [60s])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) * ((max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)) > bool (max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0))) * (1 + ((max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.gameover" | unwrap gameover_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)) > bool (max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0))))

spec.title: 💓 Heartbeat
spec.description: Has the selected host logged a heartbeat or any game event in the last 60 seconds? Independent of the time picker above. OFFLINE until the game.heartbeat telemetry change is built onto the cabinet.

spec.title: 💰 Credits available
spec.description: Coins inserted minus games started, in the selected time range (today, by default) — clamped at 0. A credit carried across midnight won't show until it's spent or another coin is inserted today.

spec.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT `__value__` FROM A) - (SELECT `__value__` FROM B)) > 0 THEN ((SELECT `__value__` FROM A) - (SELECT `__value__` FROM B)) ELSE 0 END AS credits

spec.title: 💰 Coins inserted
spec.description: game.coin_inserted events in the selected time range (today, by default) on the selected host — one per physical coin.

spec.title: 💰 Revenue
spec.description: Coins inserted in the selected time range (today, by default) × $0.25/coin. Gauge maxes out at $20 — the number in the middle keeps showing the real total even past that.

spec.title: ⏱️ Time since last game
spec.description: Minutes since the most recently started game began, for the selected host — a long gap means the cabinet has been sitting idle, not earning. Floored to a whole minute.

spec.expr: max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.expression: SELECT FLOOR(($__to - `__value__`) / 60000.0) AS minutes_since_start FROM A

spec.title: ⏱️ Latest game duration
spec.description: How long the most recently started game has lasted: counts up live from its start time while still in progress (latest start newer than latest end), otherwise end minus start — for the selected host in the selected time range.

spec.expr: max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)
max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT `__value__` FROM A) > (SELECT `__value__` FROM B) THEN ($__to - (SELECT `__value__` FROM A)) / 1000.0 ELSE ((SELECT `__value__` FROM B) - (SELECT `__value__` FROM A)) / 1000.0 END AS duration_seconds

spec.title: ⏱️ Average game duration
spec.description: Mean game length (session.end minus session.start) across completed games for the selected host, in the selected time range.

spec.expr: max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))
max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range]))

spec.expression: SELECT AVG((b.`__value__` - a.`__value__`)/1000.0) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM A a JOIN B b ON a.session_label = b.session_label

spec.title: 📊 Utilization
spec.description: Percentage of the time the machine has been ON today (since the first heartbeat seen in the selected range) spent PLAYING, for the selected host — sum of completed games' durations ÷ (now minus first heartbeat). A game still in progress isn't counted until it ends.

spec.expr: max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))
max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range]))

spec.expression: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.`__value__` - a.`__value__`), 0) / ($__to - (SELECT `__value__` FROM D)) * 100.0 AS utilization_pct FROM A a JOIN B b ON a.session_label = b.session_label

spec.title: 📊 Utilization
spec.description: Percentage of the time the machine has been ON today (since the first heartbeat seen in the selected range) spent PLAYING, for the selected host — sum of completed games' durations ÷ (now minus first heartbeat). A game still in progress isn't counted until it ends.

spec.expr: max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))
max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range]))

spec.expression: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.`__value__` - a.`__value__`), 0) / ($__to - (SELECT `__value__` FROM D)) * 100.0 AS utilization_pct FROM A a JOIN B b ON a.session_label = b.session_label

spec.title: 🏎️ Games played
spec.description: game.session.start events in the selected time range (today, by default) on the selected host.

spec.title: 🏁 Completion rate
spec.description: Percentage of today's games on the selected host that reached the goal line, vs. timing out. A high rate can mean the difficulty is set too easy — hence red at the high end, not green.

spec.expr: avg(avg_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.gameover" | unwrap completed [$__range])) * 100 or vector(0)

spec.title: 🥧 Time in each state
spec.description: Percentage of today's up-time (since the first heartbeat seen today) spent in each lifecycle state, for the selected host. A game still in progress or still in post game right now is counted up to this instant.

spec.expr: max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range]))
max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range]))
max by (session_label) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.gameover" | unwrap gameover_epoch_ms [$__range]))

spec.expression: SELECT CASE WHEN (total_on - playing - postgame) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE (total_on - playing - postgame) END / total_on * 100.0 AS `Attract mode`, playing / total_on * 100.0 AS `Playing`, postgame / total_on * 100.0 AS `Post game` FROM (SELECT $__to - (SELECT `__value__` FROM D) AS total_on, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.`__value__` IS NOT NULL THEN c.`__value__` ELSE COALESCE(b.`__value__`, $__to) END - a.`__value__`), 0) AS playing, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(b.`__value__`, $__to) - CASE WHEN c.`__value__` IS NOT NULL THEN c.`__value__` ELSE COALESCE(b.`__value__`, $__to) END), 0) AS postgame FROM A a LEFT JOIN B b ON a.session_label = b.session_label LEFT JOIN C c ON a.session_label = c.session_label) q

spec.title: 🚗 Car colour
spec.description: Configured car colour (config.xml <engine><car_color>, car_pal 0-4) from the most recent game.startup on the selected host.

spec.title: 🕹️ Gearbox mode
spec.description: Configured transmission mode (automatic/manual) from the most recent game.startup on the selected host.

spec.title: 🎯 Difficulty
spec.description: Configured game-time DIP-switch difficulty from the most recent game.startup on the selected host.

spec.title: 🚦 Traffic difficulty
spec.description: Configured traffic DIP-switch difficulty from the most recent game.startup on the selected host.

spec.title: 🔁 Engine lifecycle
spec.description: Attract mode -> Playing -> Post game -> Attract mode, for the selected host, right now. The lit node matches whatever Engine state (above) currently shows; the other two stay grey. Unknown (host not alive) leaves every node grey.

spec.expr: (1 - ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" [60s])) or vector(0)) > bool 0)) * 3 + ((sum(count_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" [60s])) or vector(0)) > bool 0) * ((max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)) > bool (max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.end" | unwrap end_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0))) * (1 + ((max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.gameover" | unwrap gameover_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)) > bool (max(last_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.session.start" | unwrap start_epoch_ms [$__range])) or vector(0))))

spec.expression: SELECT 'attract' AS state_id, CASE WHEN `__value__` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active FROM A UNION ALL SELECT 'playing', CASE WHEN `__value__` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM A UNION ALL SELECT 'postgame', CASE WHEN `__value__` = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM A

spec.title: 📈 Cumulative revenue
spec.description: Running total revenue (game.coin_inserted events × $0.25/coin) across the selected range, for the selected host. Updates live as coins are inserted — no hourly bucketing, so there's no lag waiting for an hour to complete.

spec.title: 🎵 Music plays
spec.description: Count of games started with each music track, for the selected host in the selected time range.

spec.expression: SELECT t.label AS track, COALESCE(SUM(a.cnt), 0) AS plays FROM (SELECT '0' AS v, 'Magical Sound Shower' AS label UNION ALL SELECT '1','Passing Breeze' UNION ALL SELECT '2','Splash Wave' UNION ALL SELECT '3','Custom') t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(music_selection AS SIGNED) >= 3 THEN '3' ELSE music_selection END AS v, `__value__` AS cnt FROM A) a ON a.v = t.v GROUP BY t.label, t.v ORDER BY t.v

spec.title: 🪙 Coin inserts
spec.description: Every game.coin_inserted event on the selected host, newest first.

spec.expr: {service_name="cannonball-se"} | host_name="$host" | event="game.coin_inserted" | line_format "Coin inserted — {{.credits}} credit(s) now in machine"

spec.title: 📜 Raw event log
spec.description: Every event for the selected host in the selected time range (today, by default), newest first — the full, unfiltered feed from whatever game is running now (or the most recent one, in attract mode).

spec.title: 📸 Latest screenshot
spec.description: The most recent screenshot captured on the selected host, from whichever event logged it last (game start, stage checkpoint, course map, or game over).

options.defaultContent: No screenshot yet for this host.

spec.title: 🕐 Captured
spec.description: How long ago the latest screenshot (left) was captured.
